title: Canonical explorer addresses
responsibility: Maps earlier console addresses into explorer pages and chooses a useful indexed branch or retained commit when none is selected.

inputs.name: defaultCommit.index
inputs.description: Indexed branches and revisions used to resolve a requested commit or fallback.

inputs.name: defaultCommit.asked
inputs.description: Requested commit id; used only when present in the index.

inputs.name: commitBranch.index
inputs.description: Indexed revisions and their containing branches.

inputs.name: commitBranch.commit
inputs.description: Commit whose containing branch should be chosen.

inputs.name: explorerHome.index
inputs.description: Indexed branches and revisions available for the initial Pages view.

inputs.name: explorerExact.path
inputs.description: Explorer path without the host base; trailing slashes are ignored.

inputs.name: explorerExact.search
inputs.description: Optional query string, defaulting to empty; a tab is included when checking the canonical form.

inputs.name: explorerAddress.index
inputs.description: History index used to resolve old addresses and fallback selections.

inputs.name: explorerAddress.path
inputs.description: Path relative to the console base, including root, legacy page, report, analytics or explorer routes.

inputs.name: explorerAddress.search
inputs.description: Optional query string carrying legacy selection or explorer tab state; defaults to empty.

inputs.name: consoleCanonical.index
inputs.description: History index used to resolve the requested address.

inputs.name: consoleCanonical.url
inputs.description: Current URL whose path and query should be normalized.

inputs.name: consoleCanonical.base
inputs.description: Host route prefix to remove before parsing and prepend to a replacement path.

outputs.name: defaultCommit
outputs.description: Requested known commit, otherwise an indexed main/master branch head, another indexed head, first revision, or an empty string.

outputs.name: commitBranch
outputs.description: First main/master branch containing the commit, otherwise its first branch, or null when none is recorded.

outputs.name: explorerHome
outputs.description: Pages location at an indexed preferred or first branch tip, otherwise the first retained revision with no branch; undefined for an empty history.

outputs.name: explorerExact
outputs.description: True when the path and recognized tab/helper selection already match the explorer formatter’s output after removing trailing slashes.

outputs.name: explorerAddress
outputs.description: Replacement explorer path for a recognized noncanonical address; undefined for an exact explorer address or an unrecognized path.

outputs.name: consoleCanonical
outputs.description: Replacement path including the host base, or undefined when no replacement is resolved. This helper returns text and does not perform a redirect.
